name: quran-cross-references
description: An interactive bilingual Quran cross-reference explorer.

scripts.dev: npm run data:quran && npm run assets:quran && vite
scripts.build: npm run data:quran && npm run assets:quran && tsc -b && vite build && npm run pwa:build
scripts.format:check: prettier --write src/core/quran/verse-search.test.ts src/quran/QuranVerseSearch.tsx tests/e2e/quran-reader.spec.ts && git diff -- src/core/quran/verse-search.test.ts src/quran/QuranVerseSearch.tsx tests/e2e/quran-reader.spec.ts && exit 1
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecoverage && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test:coverage
scripts.data:quran: node scripts/quran/fetch-qac.ts && node scripts/quran/fetch-qsac.ts && node scripts/quran/fetch-elqv.ts && node scripts/quran/build.ts
